overview.description: Epic breakdown for the local Agile Agent Canvas workbench that governs Visual Studio Code Insiders agent surfaces for Cabina Universal.

epics.title: Seed the Cabina canvas
epics.description: Replace demo root canvas artifacts with Cabina Universal Agent Control artifacts and keep them parseable, explicit, and reversible.

stories.title: Replace demo vision
stories.description: Root vision identifies Cabina Universal Agent Control and declares local-only boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: projectName is Cabina Universal Agent Control
no secret or live target appears

stories.title: Add canvas README
stories.description: README describes versioned artifacts, blocked live lanes, and rollback.

stories.title: Stage allowlisted canvas package
stories.description: Because root files are ignored, stage only reviewed canvas files explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: git status shows only explicit canvas files plus intended matrices

epics.title: Govern VSI agent surfaces
epics.description: Keep Agile Agent Canvas, related agent extensions, and local tools mapped to gates and validators.

stories.title: Inventory installed agent extensions
stories.description: Use code-insiders extension list as evidence for local agent-capable surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Agile Agent Canvas version is captured

stories.title: Classify Agile Agent Canvas tools
stories.description: Separate read, write, Jira, Graphify, skill catalogue, and Codeburn surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: each surface has allowed and blocked actions
each surface has gate and stop condition

stories.title: Prepare user catalogue lane
stories.description: Define target path and rollback before changing userCataloguePath or cloning skill repos.
acceptanceCriteria: no external clone happens without gate

epics.title: Bridge canvas and dashboard
epics.description: Expose canvas readiness in the local operator dashboard alongside existing agent and governance controls.

stories.title: Show canvas package status
stories.description: Dashboard reports whether root canvas artifacts parse and identify Cabina.

stories.title: Show next gated lanes
stories.description: Dashboard lists pending Jira, user catalogue, Graphify, OpenAI live, and Microsoft live gates.

epics.title: Prepare live-gated expansion
epics.description: Advance live-capable surfaces only as dry-run or order packets until exact target, owner, rollback, postcheck, evidence, and validator exist.

stories.title: Prepare Jira read gate
stories.description: Document Jira target, owner, token handling, data limit, rollback, and postcheck before any Jira read.

stories.title: Prepare OpenAI/Agents SDK live gate
stories.description: Define allowed payload, cost boundary, secret source, eval, rollback, and stop condition.
acceptanceCriteria: no live call happens without gate

stories.title: Prepare Microsoft live gate
stories.description: Define tenant, identity, target, owner, rollback, postcheck, and validator before Graph, Teams, SharePoint, Planner, Dataverse, or Power Platform mutation.
